formulario.limite_autoaprovacao_ajuda: The maximum variation from the current price that this policy lets through on its own. Without a value, every suggestion from this policy stays pending review.

politicas.descricao: The policies in effect now. The most specific one wins: product over category, category over company.

simulacao.descricao: Calculates the suggested price for a product, without changing the price in effect.
simulacao.vazio: No simulations yet for this product.

motivo.COLISAO_NO_MESMO_NIVEL: Two policies at the same level conflict
motivo.DENOMINADOR_INVALIDO: Margin plus fee add up to 100% or more — no possible price
motivo.SEM_LIMITE_DE_AUTOAPROVACAO: This policy has no auto-approval limit
motivo.VARIACAO_ACIMA_DO_LIMITE: The variation from the current price exceeds the policy's limit
